slides.text: The Mystery of Meditation
Isaiah 1:18-19 Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD. If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land.
God is inviting us to engage in meditation for a desired change of story

Joshua 1:8 This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.

Psalm 1:1-3 Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful. But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night. And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
Meditation is word-thinking, not free-thinking
What is meditation? 1. Thinking through scriptures in search of the way out of issues of concern in our lives
Genesis 24:63 And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide
2. Reasoning through scriptures on the way forward in one's endeavours

Psalm 119:97-100 O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day. Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies. I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation. I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
Meditation requires quietness
Proverbs 18:1 Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.
1 Kings 19:4 He requested for himself that he might die
1 Kings 19:12 And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
3. Pondering through scriptures in search of answers to the bugging questions of life
Luke 15:17 And when he came to himself
4. Thinking through scriptures to find the way out of our predicament

2 Corinthians 10:3-5 For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh: for the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds; casting down imaginations, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ
Meditation is mental warfare
Two months too much!
Colossians 3:16 Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom
1 Timothy 4:13-15 Give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine. Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
Why is the Bible the answer book of life, and yet we are still struggling with too many questions?
Matthew 11:28-29 Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
Deuteronomy 15:6 Thou shalt lend unto many nations, but thou shalt not borrow
1 Kings 4:29 And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.
Consciously create separation seasons in our lives
Isaiah 55:9-11 For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts. So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth
The Word is the way out of every unwanted situation in our lives
Meditation grants us access to the answers; the fear of the Lord guarantees delivery
Isaiah 66:2-3 But to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at my word.
Mind what the Word says. Those who won't mind the Word, the Word will not mind them.
The answers come as kingdom principles, reproof, correction and instruction
Instructions are the highways of life
Job 6:25 How forcible are right words!
Whatever God says, God creates when we receive and believe it
There is no intellectual access to the covenant of life embedded in scriptures
1 Corinthians 2:14 But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
Romans 8:6 For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.
James 1:5 If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

1 Corinthians 10:13 There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape
Hebrews 6:12 That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
Only a serious approach guarantees a glorious result
Hebrews 13:7 Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.
Meditation is a spiritual asset
Life-transforming outcomes of meditation
Daniel 11:32 But the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.
You don't need to know any man to scale the utmost height in life. Just know me.
Philippians 3:10 That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection
Proverbs 4:18 But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
Meditation is like squeezing the juice from the orange
One major raw material for meditation is time
Jeremiah 33:20-21 If ye can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, then may also my covenant be broken
Ask Him questions. Be sincere about your questions and you are sure to have the answer.
Approach your separation times with set questions
2 Samuel 5:19 And David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto David, Go up
Isaiah 48:17 I am the LORD thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go.
In conclusion: meditation is the way to a life of continuous flourishing
Psalm 19:2 Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.

Isaiah 26:9 With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
Engage your night season
Proverbs 3:27-28 Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it. Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give
2 Corinthians 6:2 I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.
Habakkuk 2:4 The just shall live by his faith.
Write down your 'enough is enough' issues
Romans 8:32 He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
